notes.title: 🧊 "Qube Qross" demo is now available!
notes.content:
Kibi Games and Poly Poly Games are grouped by friends, we're all developers have 10+ years experience. 

We’ve planned to do this game for a year, and have tried multiple testing and designs, after several times of iterative improving, finally completed this puzzle game. 

Hope you like it, thanks for playing!
